title: Auto UV, manual UV, UV stitching, UV unwrapping

sections.heading: AUTO UNWRAP: Planar Projection, Projection Axis Selection, Anchor, Transform, and World Space Algorithm
sections.content:
The ProBuilder automatic UV unwrapping pipeline executes a deterministic multi-stage algorithm that projects 3D mesh vertices into 2D UV texture space and applies user-defined transformations. The entry point is `UvUnwrapping.Unwrap(ProBuilderMesh mesh, Face face, Vector3 projection = default)`, which invokes `Projection.PlanarProject(mesh, face, projection)` followed by `UvUnwrapping.ApplyUVSettings(mesh.texturesInternal, face.distinctIndexesInternal, face.uv)`.

1. Face Normal to Projection Axis Determination:
In `Projection.PlanarProject(mesh, face, projection)`, the algorithm calculates the unit face normal `nrm = Math.EnsureUnitVector(Math.Normal(mesh, face))`. If `face.uv.useWorldSpace` is enabled (`true`), the normal vector is transformed into world coordinates via `mesh.transform.TransformDirection(nrm)`. When the optional `projection` vector parameter is `Vector3.zero`, the cardinal projection axis is calculated by `Projection.VectorToProjectionAxis(nrm)`. This evaluates the absolute components $|x|, |y|, |z|$ of `direction`:
- If `!Math.Approx(x, y) && x > y && !Math.Approx(x, z) && x > z`: returns `ProjectionAxis.X` (if `direction.x > 0`) or `ProjectionAxis.XNegative`.
- Else if `!Math.Approx(y, z) && y > z`: returns `ProjectionAxis.Y` (if `direction.y > 0`) or `ProjectionAxis.YNegative`.
- Else: returns `ProjectionAxis.Z` (if `direction.z > 0`) or `ProjectionAxis.ZNegative`.

The tangent vector `prj` is derived via `Projection.GetTangentToAxis(axis)`:
- `ProjectionAxis.X` / `ProjectionAxis.XNegative`: returns `Vector3.up` $(0, 1, 0)$.
- `ProjectionAxis.Y` / `ProjectionAxis.YNegative`: returns `Vector3.forward` $(0, 0, 1)$.
- `ProjectionAxis.Z` / `ProjectionAxis.ZNegative`: returns `Vector3.up` $(0, 1, 0)$.

The orthonormal 2D projection basis vectors are computed:
`uAxis = Vector3.Cross(nrm, prj)` normalized, and `vAxis = Vector3.Cross(uAxis, nrm)` normalized.
For each vertex position $p$ of the face (transformed by `mesh.transform.TransformPoint(p)` if `useWorldSpace` is active), initial UV coordinates are projected as dot products:
`textures[index].x = Vector3.Dot(uAxis, p)`
`textures[index].y = Vector3.Dot(vAxis, p)`

2. Application of `AutoUnwrapSettings`:
`UvUnwrapping.ApplyUVSettings` transforms projected coordinates according to `AutoUnwrapSettings` in strict sequence:
- `Fill` Mode: Computes 2D bounding box `Bounds2D bounds = new Bounds2D(uvs, indexes)`.
  - `AutoUnwrapSettings.Fill.Tile`: Bounds are unadjusted.
  - `AutoUnwrapSettings.Fill.Fit`: Calculates `max = Mathf.Max(bounds.size.x, bounds.size.y)`. Calls `ScaleUVs(uvs, indexes, new Vector2(max, max), bounds)` to uniformly fit UVs inside a $1 \times 1$ square while preserving aspect ratio, setting `bounds.center /= max`.
  - `AutoUnwrapSettings.Fill.Stretch`: Calls `ScaleUVs(uvs, indexes, bounds.size, bounds)` to independently scale width and height to $1.0$, setting `bounds.center /= bounds.size`.
- `Scale` and `Rotation`: When `uvSettings.scale` differs from $(1, 1)$ or `uvSettings.rotation` is non-zero, an offset is calculated: `Vector2 scaledCenter = bounds.center * uvSettings.scale`, `Vector2 delta = bounds.center - scaledCenter`, `Vector2 center = scaledCenter`. Each UV coordinate is translated by `-delta`, scaled around `center` via `ScaleAroundPoint(center, uvSettings.scale)`, and rotated clockwise around `center` via `RotateAroundPoint(center, uvSettings.rotation)`.
- `Anchor`: When `!uvSettings.useWorldSpace` and `uvSettings.anchor != AutoUnwrapSettings.Anchor.None`, `ApplyUVAnchor` aligns the bounding box min/max points:
  - X translation: `UpperLeft`/`MiddleLeft`/`LowerLeft` shifts by `min.x`; `UpperRight`/`MiddleRight`/`LowerRight` shifts by `max.x - 1f`; `UpperCenter`/`MiddleCenter`/`LowerCenter` shifts by `(min.x + (max.x - min.x) * 0.5f) - 0.5f`.
  - Y translation: `UpperLeft`/`UpperCenter`/`UpperRight` shifts by `max.y - 1f`; `MiddleLeft`/`MiddleCenter`/`MiddleRight` shifts by `(min.y + (max.y - min.y) * 0.5f) - 0.5f`; `LowerLeft`/`LowerCenter`/`LowerRight` shifts by `min.y`.
- Coordinate Flips and Swaps: If `uvSettings.flipU` is true, $u = -u$. If `uvSettings.flipV` is true, $v = -v$. If `uvSettings.swapUV` is true, $(u, v)$ becomes $(v, u)$.
- `Offset`: Translates all vertex coordinates by subtracting offset: `uvs[index].x -= uvSettings.offset.x`, `uvs[index].y -= uvSettings.offset.y`.

3. `useWorldSpace` Flag Behavior:
When `useWorldSpace` is `true`:
- Vertex positions are converted to world coordinates prior to dot product projection (`trs.TransformPoint(positions[indexes[i]])`).
- The face normal is transformed into world space (`trs.TransformDirection(nrm)`).
- Anchor alignment is bypassed (`if (!uvSettings.useWorldSpace && uvSettings.anchor != AutoUnwrapSettings.Anchor.None)`).
- In `AutoUVEditor.OnGUI`, the anchor dropdown control is disabled (`GUI.enabled = !s_AutoUVSettings.useWorldSpace`).
- Moving the object in 3D world space dynamically shifts projected texture mapping coordinates across the surface.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, auto planar UV unwrapping can be implemented in a MeshLibrary or custom Tool script using Transform3D and Basis operations. VectorToProjectionAxis translates to comparing abs(normal.x), abs(normal.y), abs(normal.z) with Math.is_equal_approx. ArrayMesh UV channels (Vector2 PackedVector2Array) receive projected coordinates.

sections.heading: MANUAL UV: Per-Face Manual Data Model, Element & Shared Texture Groups, and Editor Manipulation
sections.content:
Manual UV mode enables direct, arbitrary per-vertex UV manipulation without constraint to planar auto-unwrap transformations.

1. Per-Face Manual Data Model:
- `Face.manualUV` (`bool m_ManualUV`): Serialized boolean indicating whether the face is in manual UV mode (`true`) or auto UV mode (`false`). When `true`, mesh operations skip auto-unwrapping passes during geometry updates.
- `Face.uv` (`AutoUnwrapSettings m_Uv`): Serialized `AutoUnwrapSettings` struct preserved on the face even while in manual mode. When manual, it retains prior auto settings (or defaults to `AutoUnwrapSettings.tile`) for reference when converting back.
- `Face.elementGroup` (`int elementGroup`): Group identifier indicating connected UV islands or element groups. Set to `-1` when faces are split or manually projected.
- `Face.textureGroup` (`int m_TextureGroup`): Group identifier set to `-1` for manual faces; auto-projection grouping is deactivated.
- `ProBuilderMesh.texturesInternal` (`Vector2[]` / `mesh.textures`): Stores per-vertex UV coordinates for UV channel 0 (diffuse texture mapping). Secondary UV channels are accessed via `UVEditing.GetUVs(ProBuilderMesh mesh, int channel)` and written with `UVEditing.ApplyUVs(ProBuilderMesh mesh, Vector2[] uvs, int channel, bool applyToMesh = true)`:
  - Channel 0: `mesh.texturesInternal` and `mesh.mesh.uv`.
  - Channel 1: `mesh.mesh.uv2` (lightmap UVs).
  - Channels 2 and 3: `mesh.GetUVs(channel, list)` / `mesh.SetUVs(channel, list)` using `Vector4` buffers converted to/from `Vector2`.
- `ProBuilderMesh.sharedTextures` (`SharedVertex[]`) and `ProBuilderMesh.sharedTextureLookup` (`Dictionary<int, int>`): Stores UV seam topology. Vertices sharing identical UV coordinates across edges share coincident entries in `sharedTextureLookup`.

2. User Editing and Interaction:
- Sub-element Selection: The UV Editor supports vertex, edge, and face selection modes. In `AutoUVEditor.OnGUI`, if any selected face has `manualUV == true`, `s_AutoUVSettingsDiff["manualUV"]` is set to `true`.
- Selection Expansion:
  - `Select Island`: Traverses `sharedTextureLookup` to select all connected faces and vertices belonging to the contiguous UV island.
  - `Select Face`: Expands the selection from any selected UV vertex or edge to encompass all vertices on that face.
- Manual Transformation: Direct translation, rotation, and scaling gizmos operate on arbitrary sets of UV vertices in the UV viewer window.
- Resetting UVs: In `AutoUVEditor.OnGUI` (lines 244-257), clicking `Reset UVs` executes:
  - Sets `face.uv = AutoUnwrapSettings.tile`
  - Sets `face.textureGroup = -1`
  - Sets `face.elementGroup = -1`
  - Invokes `UVEditing.SplitUVs(selection[i], selection[i].GetSelectedFaces())` to separate shared UV indices.
sections.godot_notes: Godot represents manual UVs in ArrayMesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV and ArrayMesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2 PackedVector2Array buffers. Shared vertex seam equivalence classes can be modeled via a custom Disjoint-Set / Union-Find structure or Dictionary[int, int].

sections.heading: UV STITCHING: TextureStitching Algorithm, Edge Alignment, Scale/Rotation/Translation Matching, and Triggering
sections.content:
The UV stitching algorithm merges the UV coordinates of two geometrically adjacent faces along their shared edge, aligning orientation, scale, and translation in UV space. The primary implementation is `UVEditing.AutoStitch(ProBuilderMesh mesh, Face f1, Face f2, int channel)` located in `TextureStitching.cs`.

1. `AutoStitch` Execution Workflow:
- Topology Discovery: Identifies boundary connectivity between anchor face `f1` and destination face `f2` via `WingedEdge.GetWingedEdges(mesh, new [] { f1, f2 })`. Locates `sharedEdge = wings.FirstOrDefault(x => x.face == f1 && x.opposite != null && x.opposite.face == f2)`. If no shared edge exists, returns `false`.
- Mode and Group Reset: If `f1.manualUV` is true, sets `f2.manualUV = true`. Resets texture groups on both faces: `f1.textureGroup = -1` and `f2.textureGroup = -1`.
- Destination Projection: Calls `Projection.PlanarProject(mesh, f2)` to generate base 2D coordinates for the target face.
- Edge Alignment: Calls `AlignEdges(mesh, f2, sharedEdge.edge.local, sharedEdge.opposite.edge.local, channel)`.
- Auto-Unwrap Alignment: If `!f2.manualUV`, invokes `UvUnwrapping.SetAutoAndAlignUnwrapParamsToUVs(mesh, new [] { f2 })` to recompute `AutoUnwrapSettings` matching the newly stitched UV layout.

2. Step-by-Step `AlignEdges` Algorithm:
`AlignEdges(ProBuilderMesh mesh, Face faceToMove, Edge edgeToAlignTo, Edge edgeToBeAligned, int channel)` executes the following:
- Vertex Matching: Identifies corresponding vertices on the shared edge. Checks `siIndex = mesh.GetSharedVertexHandle(edgeToAlignTo.a)`. If `sharedIndexes[siIndex].Contains(edgeToBeAligned.a)`, sets `matchX = [edgeToAlignTo.a, edgeToBeAligned.a]` and `matchY = [edgeToAlignTo.b, edgeToBeAligned.b]`; otherwise sets `matchX = [edgeToAlignTo.a, edgeToBeAligned.b]` and `matchY = [edgeToAlignTo.b, edgeToBeAligned.a]`.
- Scale Matching: Calculates 2D UV edge lengths `dist_e1 = Vector2.Distance(uvs[edgeToAlignTo.a], uvs[edgeToAlignTo.b])` and `dist_e2 = Vector2.Distance(uvs[edgeToBeAligned.a], uvs[edgeToBeAligned.b])`. Computes ratio `scale = dist_e1 / dist_e2`. Scales all UV coordinates in `faceToMove` around `Vector2.zero` by `Vector2.one * scale`.
- Translation Alignment: Calculates UV edge midpoints `f1_center = (uvs[edgeToAlignTo.a] + uvs[edgeToAlignTo.b]) / 2f` and `f2_center = (uvs[edgeToBeAligned.a] + uvs[edgeToBeAligned.b]) / 2f`. Computes offset `diff = f1_center - f2_center` and translates all UV vertices of `faceToMove` by `+diff`, positioning `f2_center` directly on `f1_center`.
- Rotation Alignment: Computes direction vectors `angle1 = uvs[matchY[0]] - uvs[matchX[0]]` and `angle2 = uvs[matchY[1]] - uvs[matchX[1]]`. Computes angular difference `angle = Vector2.Angle(angle1, angle2)`. If `Vector3.Cross(angle1, angle2).z < 0`, sets `angle = 360f - angle`. Rotates all UVs of `faceToMove` around `f1_center` by `angle`.
- Error Verification & 180° Ambiguity Resolution: Evaluates total positional error: `error = Mathf.Abs(Vector2.Distance(uvs[matchX[0]], uvs[matchX[1]])) + Mathf.Abs(Vector2.Distance(uvs[matchY[0]], uvs[matchY[1]]))`. If `error > 0.02f`, attempts a 180° rotation around `f1_center` and calculates candidate error `e2`. If `e2 < error`, retains the 180° flip; otherwise reverts rotation by 180°.
- Shared UV Welding: Isolates prior seam mappings via `SplitUVs(mesh, faceToMove.distinctIndexesInternal)`, welds coincident UV vertices using `mesh.SetTexturesCoincident(matchX)` and `mesh.SetTexturesCoincident(matchY)`, and commits the updated coordinates with `ApplyUVs(mesh, uvs, channel)`.

3. Auto-Stitching Triggers:
Auto-stitching triggers interactively in the UV Editor when a user selects an anchor face in UV Face mode, then `Ctrl+Click`s an adjacent face in the Scene View sharing a geometric edge. Consecutive adjacent faces can be stitched in sequence via repeated `Ctrl+Click` interactions.
sections.godot_notes: Godot edge-stitching requires half-edge or winged-edge mesh traversal to identify matching vertex indices along shared geometric edges. The 2D affine transformation sequence (scale -> translate midpoint -> rotate -> 180-degree error test) can be implemented using Transform2D.

sections.heading: AUTO-MANUAL CONVERSION: Bidirectional Mode Switching, Delta Calculation, Transformation Recovery, and Data Loss Invariants
sections.content:
Conversion between Auto UV and Manual UV modes allows switching between parametric planar projection and freeform per-vertex UV manipulation. The conversion logic is implemented in `UvAutoManualConversion.cs`.

1. Auto to Manual Conversion:
Invoking `UvUnwrapping.SetAutoUV(mesh, faces, auto: false)` executes:
- For each face: sets `f.textureGroup = -1` and `f.manualUV = true`.
- Existing UV vertex coordinates in `mesh.texturesInternal` are preserved verbatim without alteration or loss of precision.
- Subsequent per-vertex edits in the UV editor modify `mesh.texturesInternal` directly while bypassing auto-projection updates.

2. Manual to Auto Conversion:
Invoking `UvUnwrapping.SetAutoUV(mesh, faces, auto: true)` delegates to `UvUnwrapping.SetAutoAndAlignUnwrapParamsToUVs(mesh, faces.Where(x => x.manualUV))`. The algorithm executes:
- Destination Cache: Captures current manual UV positions via `destinationTextures = mesh.textures.ToArray()`.
- State Reset: For each face in `facesToConvert`, sets `face.uv = AutoUnwrapSettings.defaultAutoUnwrapSettings`, `face.elementGroup = -1`, `face.textureGroup = -1`, and `face.manualUV = false`.
- Base Projection: Rebuilds unmodified planar projections with `mesh.RefreshUV(faces)`, yielding `unmodifiedProjection = mesh.texturesInternal`.
- Transformation Recovery via `CalculateDelta`: For each face, compares unmodified base projection vertices with `destinationTextures` via `CalculateDelta(unmodifiedProjection, face.indexesInternal, destinationTextures, face.indexesInternal)`:
  - Rotation Calculation: Determines angle between first edge vector of unmodified projection (`srcAngle = src[1] - src[0]`) and destination manual UV (`dstAngle = dst[1] - dst[0]`). Sets `rotation = Vector2.Angle(dstAngle, srcAngle)`. If `Vector2.Dot(Vector2.Perpendicular(dstAngle), srcAngle) < 0`, sets `rotation = 360f - rotation`.
  - Scale Calculation: Un-rotates destination UV points by `-rotation` around `dstCenter` via `GetRotatedSize(dst, dstIndices, dstCenter, -rotation)` to compute axis-aligned destination size `dstSize`. Computes `scale = dstSize.DivideBy(srcBounds.size)`.
  - Translation Calculation: Rotates source points by `rotation` around `srcBounds.center` to compute rotated bounding box `min` and `max`. Calculates `rotatedCenter = (min + max) * 0.5f` and `srcTransformedCenter = rotatedCenter * scale`. Translation is `dstCenter - srcTransformedCenter`.
- Applying Recovered Settings: Assigns `uv.offset = -trs.translation` (offset is inverted for historical Scene view coordinate alignment), `uv.rotation = trs.rotation`, and `uv.scale = trs.scale`. Sets `face.uv = uv`.
- Final Refresh: Calls `mesh.RefreshUV(faces)` to project UVs using the recovered `AutoUnwrapSettings`.

3. Data Preserved vs Lost:
- Preserved: Rigid 2D transformations (uniform and non-uniform scale, 2D rotation, translation offset) are converted into `AutoUnwrapSettings.scale`, `AutoUnwrapSettings.rotation`, and `AutoUnwrapSettings.offset`.
- Lost: Non-affine distortions, trapezoidal warping, per-vertex shears, and individual vertex welds that cannot be expressed as a single rigid 2D planar unwrap cannot be preserved in `AutoUnwrapSettings` and are reset to the best-fit planar projection.
sections.godot_notes: When translating to Godot, maintaining separate boolean flags (is_manual_uv) per polygon face allows preserving original unwrap parameters until explicitly overwritten. CalculateDelta can be implemented using standard Vector2 angle, dot, and Transform2D decomposition.

sections.heading: UV EDITING OPERATIONS: SewUVs, SplitUVs, CollapseUVs, ProjectFacesBox, ProjectFacesPlanar, ProjectFacesAuto, and FitUVs
sections.content:
`UVEditing.cs` provides low-level mesh manipulation methods for welding, splitting, collapsing, and projecting UV coordinates across arbitrary vertex collections and channels.

1. `SewUVs(ProBuilderMesh mesh, int[] indexes, float delta)`:
Welds coincident UV vertices within distance threshold `delta`.
- Retrieves `lookup = mesh.sharedTextureLookup` and `uvs = mesh.texturesInternal`.
- Compares all index pairs $(i, n)$ in `indexes`. Retrieves or creates shared texture IDs `a` and `b`.
- If `a == b`, continues to the next pair.
- If `Vector2.Distance(uvs[indexes[i]], uvs[indexes[n]]) < delta`:
  - Computes midpoint `Vector3 cen = (uvs[indexes[i]] + uvs[indexes[n]]) / 2f`.
  - Sets `uvs[indexes[i]] = cen` and `uvs[indexes[n]] = cen`.
  - Finds all keys mapped to `b` (`lookup.Where(x => x.Value == b).Select(y => y.Key).ToArray()`) and remaps them to `a` (`lookup[key] = a`).
- Commits changes with `mesh.SetSharedTextures(lookup)`.

2. `SplitUVs(ProBuilderMesh mesh, IEnumerable<int> indexes)` and `SplitUVs(ProBuilderMesh mesh, IEnumerable<Face> faces)`:
Disassociates shared UV vertices, creating separate seam boundaries.
- Retrieves `lookup = mesh.sharedTextureLookup` and initializes counter `index = lookup.Count`.
- Iterates over each vertex index in `indexes` (or `face.distinctIndexesInternal`): if `lookup.TryGetValue(vertex, out a)` succeeds, assigns `lookup[vertex] = index++`.
- Commits updated seam table via `mesh.SetSharedTextures(lookup)`.

3. `CollapseUVs(ProBuilderMesh mesh, int[] indexes)`:
Flattens all passed UV vertices to their collective average center point regardless of distance.
- Computes `Vector2 cen = Math.Average(ArrayUtility.ValuesWithIndexes(uvs, indexes))`.
- Sets `uvs[i] = cen` for all $i \in \text{indexes}$.
- Merges indices into a single shared UV group via `mesh.SetTexturesCoincident(indexes)`.

4. `ProjectFacesBox(ProBuilderMesh mesh, Face[] faces, int channel = 0)`:
Projects UVs using the nearest cardinal box plane for each face normal.
- Iterates over `faces`: computes `nrm = Math.Normal(mesh, faces[i])`, resolves `ProjectionAxis axis = Projection.VectorToProjectionAxis(nrm)`, and groups faces into `Dictionary<ProjectionAxis, List<Face>> sorted`.
- Sets `face.elementGroup = -1` and `face.manualUV = true` for each face.
- For each axis group: gathers distinct vertex indices `distinct`, projects via `Projection.PlanarProject(mesh.positionsInternal, distinct, Projection.ProjectionAxisToVector(kvp.Key))`, assigns projected coordinates to `uv`, and calls `SplitUVs(mesh, distinct)`.
- Commits coordinates via `ApplyUVs(mesh, uv, channel)`.
- Overload `ProjectFacesBox(mesh, faces, lowerLeftAnchor, channel)` calculates `Vector2 minimalUV = FindMinimalUV(uvs)` and subtracts `minimalUV` from all coordinates to align the bounding box lower-left corner with $(0, 0)$.

5. `ProjectFacesPlanar` / `ProjectFacesAuto(ProBuilderMesh mesh, Face[] faces, int channel)`:
Projects faces along the collective average surface normal.
- Computes average normal `projectionDirection = (\sum Normal(mesh, face_i)) / faces.Length`.
- Projects coordinates: `Vector2[] uvs = Projection.PlanarProject(mesh.positionsInternal, ind, projectionDirection)`.
- Assigns coordinates into rebuilt UV array and writes to mesh via `ApplyUVs(mesh, rebuiltUVs, channel)`.
- Sets `face.elementGroup = -1` and calls `SplitUVs(mesh, f.distinctIndexesInternal)` for each face.
- Automatically sews internal seams between adjacent selected faces: `mesh.SewUVs(faces.SelectMany(x => x.distinctIndexesInternal).ToArray(), .001f)`.
- In `UVEditor.Menu_PlanarProject()`, faces are set to `manualUV = true` and anchored to `LowerLeft` via `CenterUVsAtPoint(UVSelectionMinimalUV(), LowerLeft)`.

6. `ProjectFacesSphere(ProBuilderMesh pb, int[] indexes, int channel = 0)`:
Projects vertices onto a unit sphere centered at vertex average `cen = Math.Average(vertices, indexes)`. For each vertex $p = (\text{vert} - cen)$ normalized:
`uv.x = 0.5f + (Mathf.Atan2(p.z, p.x) / (2f * Mathf.PI))`
`uv.y = 0.5f - (Mathf.Asin(p.y) / Mathf.PI)`.

7. `FitUVs(Vector2[] uvs)`:
Normalizes UV coordinates to fit within the $[0, 1]$ unit square:
- Translates coordinates to origin: `smallestVector2 = Math.SmallestVector2(uvs)`, `uvs[i] -= smallestVector2`.
- Computes bounding maximum extent: `float scale = Math.MakeNonZero(Math.LargestValue(Math.LargestVector2(uvs)))`.
- Divides all UVs by `scale`: `uvs[i] /= scale`.
sections.godot_notes: SewUVs and SplitUVs correspond to vertex welding and splitting operations in Godot 2D UV editors. Box and planar projections can be structured as helper functions on an ImmediateMesh or SurfaceTool.

sections.heading: TEXTURE GROUPS: Group Identification, Multi-Face Planar Coordinate Projection, and Synchronization
sections.content:
Texture Groups allow multiple contiguous or co-planar faces to share a single, unified planar UV projection space as if they formed a single continuous polygon.

1. `Face.textureGroup` Field Semantics:
- `Face.textureGroup` (`int m_TextureGroup`): Integer group index. Default is `-1`, indicating the face does not belong to any texture group. Values $\ge 0$ indicate membership in a texture group.
- Group Property Synchronization: Whenever an auto UV parameter (offset, rotation, scale, fill mode, anchor, flip, swap, world space) is modified in `AutoUVEditor`, the change is propagated to all other faces sharing the same `textureGroup` index via `sel[i].SetGroupUV(q.uv, q.textureGroup)` and `ProBuilderMeshFunction.SetGroupUV(AutoUnwrapSettings settings, int group)`.

2. Group Management UI Actions in `AutoUVEditor`:
- Group Selected Faces: `TextureGroupSelectedFaces(ProBuilderMesh pb)` retrieves a new unique ID via `int texGroup = pb.GetUnusedTextureGroup()`, copies `AutoUnwrapSettings` from the first face (`faces[0].uv`), and assigns `f.textureGroup = texGroup` and `f.uv = new AutoUnwrapSettings(cont_uv)` to all selected faces.
- Set Texture Group: `SetTextureGroup(ProBuilderMesh[] selection, int tex)` assigns the specified integer ID to all selected faces and synchronizes their `AutoUnwrapSettings`.
- Break Selected Groups: `SetTextureGroup(selection, -1)` resets `textureGroup = -1` on all selected faces, decoupling them.
- Select Texture Group: `selection[i].SetSelectedFaces(Array.FindAll(selection[i].facesInternal, x => x.textureGroup == textureGroup))` selects all faces belonging to the active group.

3. Multi-Face Planar Projection Algorithm:
When unwrapping a texture group, `UvUnwrapping.ProjectTextureGroup(ProBuilderMesh mesh, int group, AutoUnwrapSettings unwrapSettings)` executes:
- Coordinate Projection via `Projection.PlanarProject(ProBuilderMesh mesh, int textureGroup, AutoUnwrapSettings unwrapSettings)`:
  - Average Normal Calculation: Accumulates face normals across all faces belonging to the group: `projectionDirection = \sum Math.Normal(mesh, faces[f])`.
  - World Space Transform: If `unwrapSettings.useWorldSpace` is true, transforms `projectionDirection = mesh.transform.TransformDirection(projectionDirection)`.
  - Basis Construction: Computes cardinal axis `axis = VectorToProjectionAxis(projectionDirection)` and tangent `prj = GetTangentToAxis(axis)`. Derives orthonormal basis `u = Vector3.Cross(projectionDirection, prj).normalized` and `v = Vector3.Cross(u, projectionDirection).normalized`.
  - Planar Coordinate Generation: For each face matching `textureGroup`, transforms vertex position $p$ (by `mesh.transform.TransformPoint(p)` if `worldSpace`), computing `textures[index].x = Vector3.Dot(u, p)` and `textures[index].y = Vector3.Dot(v, p)`.
- Unified UV Settings Application:
  - Collects all vertex indices across all faces in the texture group into `s_IndexBuffer.AddRange(face.distinctIndexesInternal)`.
  - Invokes `UvUnwrapping.ApplyUVSettings(mesh.texturesInternal, s_IndexBuffer, unwrapSettings)`. This applies bounding box calculations, `Fill` (Fit/Stretch), `Scale`, `Rotation`, `Anchor`, flips, and `Offset` across the entire group collectively as a single unified bounding box rather than per-face bounding boxes.
sections.godot_notes: Texture groups can be represented in Godot by assigning an integer group ID to faces in a custom mesh data structure. When projecting, all vertices across grouped faces are gathered into a single list to calculate a shared bounding box and projection plane.

cross_references.relationship: ProBuilderMesh core mesh representation, vertex buffer arrays (texturesInternal), and shared texture dictionary lookups (sharedTextureLookup)
Face, Edge, and WingedEdge topology structures used for face selection, edge finding, and unwrap parameters
UV Editor window UI, scene view gizmos, viewport transform controls, and manual vertex/edge selection
WingedEdge data structure utilized by AutoStitch to discover adjacent face boundaries and shared edges

open_questions: In UvUnwrapping.ApplyUVSettings, offset subtraction (uvs[i].x -= uvSettings.offset.x) is performed after anchor, scale, rotation, and flips, whereas SetAutoAndAlignUnwrapParamsToUVs negates translation (uv.offset = -trs.translation) due to legacy scene-view alignment conventions. A Godot implementation should maintain consistent directional convention across both 2D UV space and 3D spatial viewport gizmos.

In UVEditing.ProjectFacesBox, face normal cardinal axis classification uses Projection.VectorToProjectionAxis which checks absolute component dominance with Math.Approx to resolve floating-point boundary ambiguities. For exact parity on non-cardinal normals (e.g. perfectly diagonal faces at (1,1,1)), tie-breaking resolves to X/XNegative, then Y/YNegative, then Z/ZNegative.
